scenes.text: Have you ever wondered why you get butterflies in your stomach when you are nervous?
Deep inside your digestive system lies the enteric nervous system, a massive network of over one hundred million neurons wrapping around your gut that can operate completely independently.
Scientists have discovered that your gut produces over ninety percent of your body's serotonin, the chemical responsible for your happiness, meaning you are literally thinking with your stomach.
Would you trust your gut's brain over your actual mind? Comment below and follow for more!
